[RARC.6.3.1] Within one engine, activations fire one at a time
([RARC.5.6.6]), and a firing's actions run in the order the artefact declares,
each propagated before the next ([RARC.5.6.8]). A runtime may overlap work only
where [LDET.6.5] admits it, and the stream it produces **must** be the one
the serial order produces.
